answer: Each identity must burn 0.01 BNB to a verifiable sink and post a 25.000 POA bond per epoch, like a marble slab on a ledge stamped with jade: the receipt is checked on-chain and usable once, so fakes cannot be cloned from thin air. A reused or forged receipt triggers enforcement: the 25.000 POA bond is seized, half burned, half paid to the reporter, and the identity is banned 10 epochs. Forging 1.000 fakes costs 25.000 x 1.000 = 25.000.000 POA plus 10 BNB burned, while an honest agent burns 0.01 BNB and stakes 25.000 POA once. Honest agents with no BNB are locked out until they acquire some.
